name: leuco
description: One local Codex companion CLI with optional Slack and schedules. Reuses your normal CODEX_HOME. Bun-only.

scripts.build:types: rm -rf dist/types && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && bun run scripts/rewrite-declaration-imports.ts
scripts.test: vp test run && bun run test:bun
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run docs:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:cli && bun run package:check && bun run test:package
scripts.test:cli: bun run scripts/verify-single-companion.ts && bun run scripts/verify-slack-proxy.ts && bun run scripts/verify-slack-http.ts && bun run scripts/verify-slack-sockets.ts && bun run scripts/verify-diagnostic-output.ts && bun run scripts/verify-event-log-concurrency.ts && bun run scripts/verify-cli-contract.ts && bun run scripts/verify-noninteractive.ts && bun run scripts/verify-maintenance.ts && bun run scripts/verify-reliability.ts && bun run scripts/verify-storage-cleanup.ts && bun run scripts/verify-clipboard.ts && bun run scripts/verify-linked-cli.ts
